dz: 叙利亚人迈克尔(Michael the Syrian)是叙利亚最重要的历史学家之一,被尊为"叙利亚正教牧首"(Syrianc Orthic Bathory),位于莫尔·巴尔·萨乌马修道院.
de: Michael the Syrian, one of the most important Syriac historians, is consecrated as Syriac Orthodox Patriarch at the Mor Bar Sauma Monastery.
